faq_data.lam_the_nao_de_tao_tai: How do I create an account on IT Việc?
faq_data.de_tao_tai_khoan_tren_it: To create an account on IT Việc, click the "Sign up" button in the top right corner of the website. Then fill in your personal information such as full name, email and password, and follow the instructions to complete the registration.
faq_data.toi_quen_mat_khau_lam_the: I forgot my password. How do I recover it?
faq_data.neu_ban_quen_mat_khau_ban: If you forgot your password, click the "Forgot password" link on the login page. The system will send a password reset email to the address you registered with. Follow the instructions in the email to reset your password.
faq_data.lam_the_nao_de_cap_nhat: How do I update my personal profile?
faq_data.de_cap_nhat_ho_so_ca: To update your profile, sign in, click your user name in the top right corner and choose "Manage account". There you can update your personal information, work experience, skills and contact details.
faq_data.lam_the_nao_de_tim_viec: How do I find jobs that match my skills?
faq_data.it_viec_cung_cap_cong_cu: IT Việc offers advanced search that lets you filter jobs by skills, location, salary and many other criteria. You can also subscribe to job alerts to receive matching opportunities by email.
faq_data.lam_the_nao_de_ung_tuyen: How do I apply for a position?
faq_data.de_ung_tuyen_vao_mot_vi: To apply for a position, click the "Apply now" button on the job details page. You will be asked to submit your CV and can add a cover letter. Make sure your profile is complete before applying.
faq_data.toi_co_the_theo_doi_trang: How can I track the status of my applications?
faq_data.sau_khi_ung_tuyen_ban_co: After applying, sign in and open "My jobs" to track your applications. There you will see the list of positions you applied for and their current status.
faq_data.lam_the_nao_de_dang_tin: How do I post a job?
faq_data.de_dang_tin_tuyen_dung_ban: To post a job, sign in with an employer account. Then click "Post a job" and fill in the position, job requirements, salary and contact information. After reviewing, you can publish it and it will appear on the jobs page.
faq_data.chi_phi_dang_tin_tuyen_dung: How much does it cost to post a job?
faq_data.chi_phi_dang_tin_tuyen_dung_2: The cost of posting a job depends on the plan you choose. We offer several plans with different features and durations. Please visit "Pricing" to see the details and pick the one that fits your company.
faq_data.lam_the_nao_de_sang_loc: How do I screen candidates effectively?
faq_data.it_viec_cung_cap_cong_cu_2: IT Việc provides candidate management tools to help you screen efficiently. You can rate CVs, add notes, categorize candidates and track the hiring pipeline. We also offer bulk email and interview scheduling directly from the system.
faq_data.it_viec_bao_ve_du_lieu: How does IT Việc protect my personal data?
faq_data.it_viec_ap_dung_cac_bien: IT Việc applies strict security measures to protect your personal information. We use SSL encryption, store data securely and comply with data protection regulations. We never share your personal information with third parties without your consent.
faq_data.lam_the_nao_de_tang_cuong: How can I make my account more secure?
faq_data.de_tang_cuong_bao_mat_cho: To secure your account, use a strong password, change it regularly and enable two-factor authentication if available. Also make sure to sign out on public computers and keep your contact details up to date so you can recover your account when needed.
faq_data.lam_the_nao_de_bao_cao: How do I report a security issue or fraud?
faq_data.neu_ban_phat_hien_van_de: If you find a security issue or suspect fraudulent activity on IT Việc, please contact us right away at security@itviec.com or the hotline 1900 1234. Our dedicated team handles security issues and will respond as soon as possible.
